title: Settings
name: Name
profileNote: Shown in the phone preview. It stays in this browser.
photosNote: As you add a photo, Bands can use when it was taken and the city it was taken in to keep a shoot together. Lineup keeps the city, never the exact position, and neither leaves this browser. Photos already on the board are not read again. Turning a switch off does not remove what was already read.
safariNote: Safari can delete a site's data after seven days without a visit. Adding Lineup to your Home Screen or Dock protects your board. An installed app starts empty, so back up here and restore there.
backupNote: A backup is one file with your images and their order. Restoring replaces the board, and Undo brings the old one back.
backupFailed: The backup could not be made. Try again.
restored: Board restored. Undo brings back the one before.
restoreFailed: That file could not be restored. It may not be a Lineup backup, or it may be incomplete.
storageNote: Your images are kept in this browser and never leave it until you schedule a post.
folderNote: Keeps your board and your full-size originals in a folder you choose, so a cleared browser cannot touch them. An empty folder takes a copy of this board. A folder that has a board opens it.
folderInUseNote: Your originals are there at full size. Lineup adds to that folder but never changes or deletes your photos.
folderFailed: That folder could not be used. Try again, or choose another one.
folderFull: That drive is out of room. Free up some space, or choose another folder.

needs-permission.title: Open {{name}}
needs-permission.description: Your board is in this folder, and your browser needs your permission to open it again.

unreachable.title: {{name}} could not be found
unreachable.description: It may have been moved or renamed, or it may be on a drive that is not plugged in. Your board is safe in the folder.

unreadable.title: {{name}} could not be read
unreadable.description: Lineup's own files in this folder are damaged. Your photos are not affected. To start a new board there, move the hidden .lineup folder out of it, and your photos will be offered again.

folderLeaveForBrowser: Use the board in this browser
removedFiles_one: 1 photo you removed from the board is still in this folder.
removedFiles_other: {{count}} photos you removed from the board are still in this folder.

help.description: Everything here stays on this device.

actions.move: Move the image you picked up
